title: TargetZero count summary
description: Written by every TargetZero script next to its CSV records. The scorecard reads only these files. Any tool can feed the scorecard by writing a valid summary.

zero.description: Target 0 count this summary contributes to.

source.description: Platform or system, e.g. m365, gws, external, fortigate.

name.description: Short name of the check, e.g. admins, mfa, exposure.

count.description: Must equal the number of items.

complete.description: False when the check could not see everything (missing permission, licence, unreachable system). The scorecard flags incomplete counts.

notes.description: Which path was used, licence fallbacks, warnings.

record_file.description: CSV file with the full records, relative to the summary file.

items.description: Every item counted. Exceptions refer to these ids.

id.description: <source>:<stable identifier> without spaces or semicolons, e.g. m365:admin@contoso.com/global-administrator. The same item must get the same id on every run.
